title: Frostsaber
wikitext:
[[image:frostsaber.png|thumb|]]

Large cat used as a [[mount]] for the [[Night_elf|Night Elves]]. The Frostsaber is similar in appearance to a real-world [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tiger tiger], but is white with black stripes. Frostsabers can also have spots like a [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cheetah cheetah] or [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Leopard leopard]. The typical Frostsaber is a color variation of the [[Nightsaber]] - the [[Nightsaber]] is black with white stripes.  A variety of the Frostsaber is the purple [[Wintersaber]].
